05 / 06 Concept study

Bayro Cut

Barbershop · Greve, Denmark

Attitude and ritual in every cut.

02 The opportunity

Bring the energy of a neighbourhood barbershop into an experience with a brand finish.

03 The direction

Composition
The barbershop on stage, with the barber and the client at the centre of the light.
Typography
An uppercase condensed face for headings (Oswald) and Barlow for the text, in Danish.
Colour
Charcoal, leather and amber light, with gold in the highlights.
Central gesture
The clipper leaves the barber’s hand and opens up around the word Præcision.

04 The interface

The page was conceived as a single scene that unfolds as you scroll, with the content always readable without relying on the animation.

Open published prototype (opens in a new tab)

05 The motion

  1. 01 Clipper in hand
  2. 02 Clipper opened
  3. 03 Portrait

The clipper leaves the barber’s hand and becomes a featured object; body, blade and guard open up; the clipper passes through the fade and the portrait becomes the first card of the gallery.

06 Josean’s role

Visual direction and the barbershop experience.
